description: Erection of a two storey side extension incorporating the installation of one additional roof window, replacement of existing timber boundary fence with new brick wall, and replacement of the pebble dash finish to main house with smooth grey render
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( E000 - Location & Block Plans, E001 - Existing Floor Plans, Planning Statement Received: 01/12/2021
P100 - Fire Strategy, E013 - Existing Boundary Walls, Received: 06/12/2021, P111_Rev02 - Proposed Floor Plans, P112_Rev02 - Proposed Elevations, P113_Rev02 - Proposed Boundary Walls, Received: 21/02/2022 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
